summary: Compañía Cervecerías Unidas S.A. (CCU) filed its interim consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, on Form 6-K. The filing contains standard financial reporting—balance sheet, income statement, cash flows, and accounting notes—with no transactional, strategic, or corporate-action content. No acquisitions, divestitures, tender offers, or other special situations are described. The filing is routine periodic disclosure by a foreign private issuer, and it does not involve any event that would be classified as a special situation.
